title: Surreal Desert Eye Scene
description: A woman in a red robe and headscarf walks barefoot across sand dunes with small cacti around her. Above her floats a giant eye with a red mouse inside its pupil, a green vine, and another red mouse standing on a red and yellow sphere, all surrounded by transparent bubbles containing small desert scenes.
prompt: A woman wearing a red patterned robe and white headscarf walks barefoot across rolling sand dunes with green cacti nearby. A giant human eye floats in the purple sky above her with a small red mouse sitting inside the pupil, a green vine curls down from the eye toward a second red mouse standing on a red and yellow sphere. Many transparent bubbles float around the woman and contain tiny desert scenes inside them.
